summary: Iteration 18 testing complete. All 13 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working. Enhanced user profiles in admin panel, strain directory license editing, and login event tracking all functioning correctly.
passed_tests: ✅ Backend: GET /api/admin/users/{user_id}/profile requires admin auth (401)
✅ Backend: GET /api/admin/users/{user_id}/profile returns comprehensive data (user, activity_summary, inquiries, sample_requests, top_strains_viewed, filter_usage)
✅ Backend: GET /api/admin/users/{user_id}/profile returns 404 for invalid user
✅ Backend: Login creates analytics event with event_type='login' in analytics collection
✅ Backend: Login event appears in user profile login_count and login_history
✅ Backend: PUT /api/admin/strain-directory/{strain_id}/license requires admin auth
✅ Backend: PUT /api/admin/strain-directory/{strain_id}/license updates license_number
✅ Backend: PUT /api/admin/strain-directory/{strain_id}/license updates grower_company, grower_name, grower_email
✅ Backend: PUT /api/admin/strain-directory/{strain_id}/license updates all fields together
✅ Backend: PUT /api/admin/strain-directory/{strain_id}/license returns 404 for non-existent strain
✅ Backend: PUT /api/admin/strain-directory/{strain_id}/license returns 400 when no fields provided
✅ Backend: GET /api/auth/users excludes password_hash from response
✅ Backend: Registration with license_number field succeeds
✅ Backend: Registration without license_number succeeds (field is optional)
✅ Frontend: Users tab shows 'License #' column in table header
✅ Frontend: User names in Users table are gold-colored clickable buttons
✅ Frontend: 19 user profile buttons found with data-testid='user-profile-{userId}'
✅ Frontend: User detail modal opens when clicking user name
✅ Frontend: Modal shows user info grid (Phone, Country, License #, Registered date)
✅ Frontend: Modal shows Activity Summary (Logins, Page Views, Strains Viewed, Inquiries, Sample Requests)
✅ Frontend: Modal shows Top Strains Viewed section (when user has data)
✅ Frontend: Modal shows Login History section (when user has logins)
✅ Frontend: Modal shows Filter Usage section (when user has filter data)
✅ Frontend: Strain Directory shows 'Add License #' button for strains without license_number
✅ Frontend: Strain Directory shows 'Add Info' button for strains without grower info
✅ Frontend: License inline edit form appears with input and Save/Cancel buttons
✅ Frontend: Full grower info form shows Company, Contact name, Email, License # inputs
✅ Frontend: Registration form shows 'HEALTH CANADA LICENSE # (OPTIONAL)' field
✅ Frontend: License input accepts and displays license number
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed users during backend testing for user profile and login tracking verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 features all working. Key data-testids: admin-tab-users (Users tab button), user-profile-{userId} (clickable user names), dir-add-license-{strainId} (Add License button), dir-add-grower-{strainId} (Add Info button), dir-license-input-{strainId} (license input field), dir-license-save-{strainId} (save button). 19 real users in database. 32 strains total, 1 with grower info but no license (shows Add License #), 31 without grower info (show Add Info). Login events tracked in 'analytics' collection with event_type='login'. User profile modal shows comprehensive activity data from analytics aggregation.
